_comment: Backend brain-config keys the gates flag as known exceptions. Each list is an exception list, not a to-do list: a key that becomes registered/not-writable/surfaced must be removed from here, and the gate fails if it is not. An empty list means there are none. notWritable: fieldTable keys the API refuses to write. unknownReads: keys backend code reads from getRuntimeConfig() that the config service does not register. apiOnly: registered keys with no Settings control, each with the reason it is deliberately backend-only. This is the fourth member of the family the gate closes — the other three prove a key is WRITABLE, this one proves it is REACHABLE. A key with no control and no entry here is a knob nobody can turn, which is the `toolSchemaCheck` defect (warn/strict were unreachable) one layer over.

apiOnly.enabled: The master feature switch. Set once at install and inverted by the kill switch the shell owns; a Settings toggle would fight the lifecycle gate that reads it on every request.
apiOnly.maxAgentDepth: Subagent recursion ceiling. A safety bound, not a preference — the spawn path clamps it against its own ceiling and a UI that offers a different number would lie about what is applied.
apiOnly.maxWorkbenchToolLoops: Tool-round cap. 0 (unbounded) is the shipped default and the value the harness's own runaway ladder manages; it is tuned by the eval, not by an end user.
apiOnly.budgetSoftUsd: Soft spend budget. An operator value set against a known quota, read by the budget ladder; the panel that would own it is the quotas surface, which is not built.
apiOnly.budgetSoftTokens: Soft token budget. Same shape as budgetSoftUsd — an operator value, no panel.
apiOnly.budgetWallClockSec: Soft wall-clock budget. Same shape as the two above.
apiOnly.runawayNudgeRounds: Runaway-nudge rung. One half of a two-key backstop ladder; arming one without the other is a misconfiguration the harness detects itself, so it is not offered piecemeal.
apiOnly.runawayStopRounds: Runaway-stop rung. The other half of the ladder above.
apiOnly.maxUnattendedTurns: Bot-to-Bot unattended ceiling. Absent/null means off; it is set by the bot-mode configuration that owns the unattended loop, not by a general Settings control.
apiOnly.autoRouteMinSamples: Sample floor before auto-routing is trusted. A statistics knob: the right value depends on the install's traffic, and the router reports its own confidence rather than asking.
apiOnly.consolidationIntervalHours: Memory-consolidation cadence. The consolidation pass owns its own schedule and reports the last run; a second control would drift from the one that fires.
apiOnly.introspectionIntervalHours: Introspection-pass cadence. Same shape as the consolidation cadence.
apiOnly.refineIntervalHours: Harness self-refinement cadence. Owned by the refine pass, which is itself gated by the refine panel's own switch.
apiOnly.reviewerIntervalHours: Reviewer-pass cadence. Same shape as the refine cadence.
apiOnly.reviewIntervalHours: Review-pass cadence. Same shape as the refine cadence.
apiOnly.outcomeIntervalHours: Outcome-scoring cadence. The outcome pass is scored against the turn ledger and scheduled with the other background passes.
apiOnly.outcomeWindowDays: Outcome-scoring lookback. Paired with the cadence above; a lookback without a cadence is meaningless.
apiOnly.episodicRetentionDays: Episodic-memory retention. The memory spec owns retention and the backup card reports what is kept; a per-key input would duplicate both.
apiOnly.usageRetentionDays: Usage-ledger retention. Same shape as the episodic window.
apiOnly.memoryRetireEnabled: Retirement pass switch. The memory spec's own lifecycle; flipping it from Settings would fight the pass that is running.
apiOnly.memoryRetireDays: Retirement window. Paired with the switch above.
apiOnly.profileRetireDays: Profile-retirement window. Paired with the retirement switch.
apiOnly.memoryDisuseWeight: Disuse-penalty weight. A ranker constant tuned by the retrieval eval; exposing it invites a value the ranker has not been measured at.
apiOnly.memoryDisuseCap: Disuse-penalty cap. Same shape as the weight.
apiOnly.memoryDisuseRescue: Disuse-rescue count. Same shape as the weight.
apiOnly.memoryIndexCategories: Which fact categories the boot index lists. The categories are a fixed vocabulary and the index is a prompt-budget decision; it is set by the memory spec, not per install.
apiOnly.contextReliefRotate: Context-relief rotation. An internal strategy flag the compressor owns and reports on every compaction card.
apiOnly.consolidationModelSummarize: Whether consolidation summarizes with a model. Costs tokens per pass; it follows the install's model configuration rather than a separate switch.
apiOnly.compactionPrecompute: Precompute the compaction summary ahead of the trigger. A latency/coin trade-off measured by the eval; the compaction card already reports whether a precompute hit.
apiOnly.skillArchiveEnabled: Skill-archive switch. The archive is written on the learning pass's own schedule and reported per backup by the backup card.
apiOnly.skillArchiveDays: Skill-archive window. Paired with the archive switch.
apiOnly.skillAutonomy: Whether a learned skill write applies without a human. This is a TRUST decision with a safety blast radius (it writes durable procedure memory), so it is deliberately not a toggle a casual click can arm.
apiOnly.skillAutonomyShadow: Shadow-mode the autonomy pass. The diagnostic arm of the switch above; it only makes sense to whoever armed that.
apiOnly.autonomyKinds: Which proposal kinds autonomy may apply. A comma list validated against the code's ceiling — an escalation surface, not a preference.
apiOnly.autoApplyPerDay: Daily auto-apply budget. Paired with the autonomy switch; a budget without the switch arms nothing.
apiOnly.autonomyBurnInCount: Burn-in count before autonomy is trusted. Paired with the autonomy switch.
apiOnly.escalationBudgetPerDay: Daily escalation budget. The escalation ladder owns it and reports what it spent.
apiOnly.skillLearning: The skill-learning mode (off/extract-only/propose/full). A pipeline stage, set by the learning pipeline's own configuration rather than a general control.
apiOnly.skillLearningJudgeModel: The model that judges a learned skill. A model pin: it is chosen in the model configuration, not typed into a text box.
apiOnly.titleModel: The model that names a session. A model pin, same as the judge model.
apiOnly.skillRelevanceMatch: Whether skill relevance uses lexical matching. An internal ranking strategy the skill index owns.
apiOnly.skillKeywordExpansion: Whether skill discovery expands keywords. Same shape as the relevance flag.
apiOnly.toolSchemaCheck: Tool-argument validation mode (off/warn/strict). Strict refuses a mutating tool on a typo'd argument, so arming it changes what the model can do — a trust decision, not a preference.
apiOnly.subagentMaxConcurrent: Global subagent concurrency. The orchestrator clamps it against its own ceiling and reports the applied number, so a control would show a value the runtime does not use.
apiOnly.subagentMaxIterations: Per-subagent iteration cap. A safety bound the orchestrator owns.
apiOnly.subagentMaxDepth: Subagent depth. A safety bound; the same reasoning as maxAgentDepth.
apiOnly.subagentMaxChildrenPerTurn: Per-fan-out child cap. A safety bound the fan-out path owns.
apiOnly.subagentFanoutRoundBudget: Aggregate tool rounds across one fan-out. A safety bound; 0 is the opt-out and the fan-out path reports what it charged.
apiOnly.subagentWorktreeIsolation: Whether subagents run in a worktree. A filesystem-isolation decision with a real blast radius, owned by the sandbox configuration.
apiOnly.projectMemory: Whether project memory is read. The project-memory surface owns its own scope and reports what it injected.
apiOnly.projectSkills: Whether project skills join discovery. A trust decision: it is the same trust class as the repo's own AGENTS.md, and the repo's own toggle owns it.
apiOnly.fileMemory: Whether file memory is read. The file-memory surface owns its own scope.
apiOnly.flagRateCap: Cap on the flag rate. A safety ceiling the flagging path owns.
